evidence_kind: Matching shipped DLL/PDB static reconstruction; no original binary execution, device verification or effect-factory parity claimed.

action.selection: ScriptArgs DestinationIDs/DestinationNames -> World.GetActiveMapThings -> native Unit cast mask0x221 -> owned WeaponName. Missing Units/weapons skip. Selector membership is not a separate Life/alive test.

arguments.Value: LuaTableExtensions.GetValue boxes Lua numbers as float32
arguments.ValueChangeType: case-insensitive enum: Absolute0(default and unknown), Multiply1, MultiplyBase2, Add3, ReplaceIfNull4

action.null: Exact lowercase string null becomes empty any before Weapon dispatch. No return values.

weapon.matching: Exact full case-sensitive EffectData.Name equality, all matching records, no insertion and no early break.
ordered_passes: WeaponData copied effects vector +0x998..+0x9a0, independent of projectile validity.
If Weapon+0x120 valid, copied primary ProjectileData effects vector +0x720..+0x728.
If primary SpawnOnDetonate(+0x550) is nonempty and Weapon+0x121 valid, mutate copied spawned ProjectileData effects.
Independently, if primary SpawnOnImpact(+0x568) is nonempty and spawned valid, mutate that SAME spawned effects vector again.
weapon.spawned: SpawnOnDeath does not select a pass. Relative changes can apply twice when both earlier strings are nonempty. Do not deduplicate or select distinct child objects.
weapon.callbacks: No creation, application, reapplication, clearing, Lua callback, or audio playback in this native method.
weapon.return_handling: Each reflection setter bool is ignored. Unknown properties and supported native type/change rejections leave fields unchanged and traversal continues.
weapon.identity_updates: After each matching record call, requested RefreshOnExpireWithEffect/Alt recomputes native XXH3 from the resulting string into +0x58/+0x60 even if the field write was rejected. Name changes do not recompute cached +0x50 name ID.

reflection.unknown: GetPropertyInfo UNKNOWN0 causes SetProperty false before any mutation; Weapon ignores it. Native keys are case-sensitive. The complete inventory distinguishes real unknown keys from missing DTO coverage.
reflection.source_read_difference: The source reader key ChangeType normalizes into DTO ChangeType, but runtime reflection key is m_changeType. FlashColor is source-read DTO data without a runtime reflection property. Neither source key is invented as writable.
reflection.postread_difference: DurationFrames runtime mutation does not perform source Read/PostRead Duration=frames/60 normalization.
reflection.primitives: Shared primitive_properties implements native float32 arithmetic, int absolute truncation, int Multiply roundf ties away from zero, wrapping int Add, bool/string conversions, and numeric ReplaceIfNull rejection. Wrong-type relative numeric inputs use native ConvertAnyToFloat/Int zero. Wrong-type Absolute input gives native rejection rather than replacement.

enums.m_changeType: Case-insensitive MULTIPLY1; all other text gives ADD0. Stored normalized DTO ChangeType changes.
enums.conversion: All enum properties first ConvertAnyToString and ignore relative mode. Empty any ->empty, bool->true/false, Lua float32 integral->%d otherwise %g. Type/trigger DTO integer sidecars update with fields.

reflection.MultiplyBase: EffectData vtable+0x28 returns category0. Setter mode2 selects no base and invokes GetMultipliedBaseDataValue(null,...), which dereferences null. Portable implementation explicitly rejects this execution domain before any commit; it does not copy source effect values or apply Add0.

sound_cues.setter: Native reflected Sound/ClearSound type8. Empty any (including literal null after action normalization) copies INVALID_CUE: null owner, name /EmptyCue, valid false. Empty string copies default SoundCue: null owner, empty name, valid false. Nonempty text calls actual GetSoundCue.
sound_cues.lookup: Native545c0 normalizes leading slash unless / or { already leads, retains normalized requested name even when invalid, and returns null owner plus actual validity. The production adapter calls AudioWorld.resolveCue(...,applySwaps=false), without channel allocation, swaps, RNG or playback. Unavailable namespace/GUID provider errors remain explicit.
sound_cues.source: INVALID_CUE initializer1d50 copies name initialized at1cf0 (/EmptyCue), valid false. Sound/ClearSound updates live cues sidecars; no synthetic fields scalar replaces a descriptor.

portable.action: Separate lua_effect_property.cpp member action and global registration. Uses actual Destination selectors, Actor backend, nonzero entity lifetime, matching actor.object and actor.entityHandle, native Unit class, real arsenal. Missing owned weapon skips; missing actual Unit class/arsenal explicitly errors.
portable.transaction: All selected copies stage before commit. Build replacement immutable projectile snapshots before changing mutable storage. Commit only touched effect records in place, preserving vector allocation/order/indices and unaffected records. Already-issued immutable projectile snapshots remain unchanged. This rollback behavior is a portable error-handling adaptation; no native byte-storage identity emulation is claimed.
portable.consumers: Self-effect admission/runtime, collisions and Lua callbacks read live fields, cues, enum sidecars and native IDs. Active effect dataHandle/sourceIndex bindings reacquire those same indexed records. sourceJson/effectiveFieldsJson/effectsJson remain immutable source provenance and are only parsed during catalog loading.
bounds: Names/text <=65536 bytes without embedded NUL; Lua value domain bool, finite number, string, nil. Complex tables/functions require their own explicit typed handler.
Float32-convertible input and finite float DTO/arithmetic results; signed32 source DTO validation and shared native integer conversion/wrap semantics.
Known reflected keys require existing correctly typed projected storage; missing or mismatched DTO fields are fatal, never unknown-key no-ops.
Refresh hashes use existing exact bounded nativeEffectNameHash (at most128 UTF8 bytes). Other header-ID knowledge flags remain unchanged.
MultiplyBase rejects the native null-dereference domain.
Changing Type updates data only. Existing concrete effect factory/type restrictions remain explicit at their consumers; this setter does not rebuild active effects.
portable.validation: Implementation was reviewed and git diff --check passed. Builds, source-ASAN execution, real boon replay and device behavior are owned by the root milestone; no passing test result is claimed here.
